About.title: About Me
About.subtitle: I'm learning to make games and trying to turn my ideas into something real.
About.whoAmIDesc: I love making games. I especially want to develop games for PC. For now, I'm learning Unity and turning the ideas that come to my mind into small projects and prototypes. I enjoy both programming and game design, and I know I still have a lot to learn. I'm still at the beginning of the journey, but I don't just want it. Every day, every hour, every minute, I try to push myself a little further and keep working towards my goals. In the long run, I want to gain real experience in a good team, keep improving, and eventually build a place of my own. If I'm given a chance, I want to give it everything I have and make it count.
About.interest1: Unity & C# - I'm learning Unity and reinforcing what I learn by building things.
About.interest2: Game Design - I enjoy coming up with game ideas, designing mechanics, and turning them into something playable.
About.interest3: Prototyping - I like testing ideas quickly and seeing what works.
About.interest4: Strategy & Story-Driven Games - I especially enjoy strategy and story-driven games, and I want to bring some of that into my own games.
About.interest5: Linux & Open Source - They are not my main focus, but they are still tools I use every day and subjects I enjoy.
About.philosophyDesc: I always want to get better. Being told that I can't do something usually doesn't stop me. It makes me want to work harder. I like learning from my mistakes, moving forward, and constantly pushing myself a little further.
About.currentWorkDesc: Right now, I'm learning Unity and trying to turn my own game ideas into small projects. I'm also developing this website, keeping track of what I build here, and preparing myself to become part of a good team in the future.
